Penguin Random House, Sourcebooks Buy Callisto Assets
s: May 10, 2023 - Callisto’s assets will now be managed by Sourcebooks. The purchase comes after PRH, which acquired a 45% stake in Sourcebooks in 2019, upped its ownership stake to a majority position. The announcement said there are no changes in Sourcebooks' leadership, management or publishing autonomy following the increase in PRH’s ownership position.
